assumptions: All preparations refer to the original same-process object unless the case explicitly says clone.
The initial candidate and consent pass existing validators and scanner; both reviewers return the valid allowing verdict unless specified.
Treat false-confirmation as a JavaScript runtime call; TypeScript static rejection is not the requested judgment.
Classify the call to confirmPreview; acceptance never means an upload occurred or a server verified work.

cases.scenario: The original ready preparation, returned by two allowing configured reviewers, is unchanged; confirmPreview receives its exact digest and literal true.
The original ready preparation is unchanged but confirmPreview receives a different digest.
The original ready preparation is unchanged with the exact digest, but JavaScript calls confirmPreview with false.
After preparation, edit candidate.story.lesson to another schema-valid generic lesson, recompute and replace preview_digest, and confirm with the new digest and true.
After preparation, toggle consent.community_learning, recompute and replace preview_digest, and confirm with the new digest and true.
After preparation, replace only prepared.preview with different text. Confirm with the unchanged digest and true.
After preparation, replace prepared.reviews with an empty array. Confirm with the unchanged digest and true.
JSON-serialize and parse an unchanged ready preparation, then confirm that clone with its digest and true.
Spread an unchanged ready preparation into a new outer object, keeping the exact nested references; confirm that clone.

Call prepareCandidate with a valid consent object. While asynchronous reviews wait, toggle the caller-owned consent.community_learning. Both reviews then allow; confirm the unchanged returned preparation with its own digest and true.
One reviewer changes the candidate copy it receives to another generic lesson and returns allow; the other returns allow. Confirm the unchanged returned preparation with its own digest and true.
On the original returned preparation, replace candidate.story with a new object containing exactly the same JSON keys and values inserted in reverse order. Confirm with the original digest and true.
